title.en: A billion points of light, and the map still to be made
title.zh: 十亿个光点之后，宇宙地图仍待绘成

summary.en: Euclid releases a major observational dataset for cosmic mapping, with candidate lenses and spectra opening research while final dark-universe conclusions remain ahead.
summary.zh: 欧几里得发布大规模观测数据，候选引力透镜与光谱打开研究可能，暗宇宙的最终结论仍待求证。

title.en: Europe negotiates 121 million free carbon allowances: who carries the cost?
title.zh: 欧洲拟增加约1.21亿份免费碳配额：成本由谁承担？

summary.en: A provisional heat-and-fuel benchmark deal offers industry support for2026–2030; adoption, eligibility and real emissions outcomes remain separate tests.
summary.zh: 热与燃料基准临时协议拟在2026至2030年支持工业；正式采纳、资格细则及实际排放结果仍需分别核验。
